dedupe_keys.name: hungarian dvb t spectrum measurements dataset

description: This separate Zenodo deposit holds Hungarian DVB-T television-spectrum measurements. The describing article says the national monitoring system observes the UHF DVB-T band from 470 to 694 MHz and stores field strength by time and frequency in CSV matrices. The repository names a public DVB-T.zip package under CC BY 4.0; metadata lists about 150 GB of material. The exact subset of monitoring stations and observation dates in this deposit are not specified by the landing-page description. A modeller can use the measurements to assess spectrum occupancy or evaluate a broadcast-service anomaly detector under simulated interference. The data do not identify failed transmitters or verify service loss, so a power or communications outage model would require additional infrastructure information. Signal-strength variation can reflect meteorology as well as equipment events. The archive was not downloaded or checked. It is distinct from the FM deposit at G4-0539, and no directly related catalogue record was identified.
